Heathrow’s ambition to harness data for smoother operations mirrors my recent work building end‑to‑end pipelines that turn raw data into actionable insights. I designed scikit‑learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deploying them as FastAPI services in Docker to enable real‑time decision support. 

In a separate project I proposed and prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python, utilising FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL and GitHub Actions CI. The prototype was showcased in a live stakeholder demo for a Madrid‑based product start‑up client, demonstrating rapid prototyping and stakeholder engagement. 

These experiences align directly with Heathrow’s focus on analytical models and data science solutions to improve airport operations and inform business decisions.
